page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top centre-right with page number at top left; a section heading centred below the text; then a numbered list of questions in italic with hanging indents; a catchword-like fragment "9. U-" at lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: onis non spectet, repetitio ejus, quod pro
reo principali est expensum. In eo quippe
tantum consistit natura fidejussionis, ut quis
solvere promittat, quod alius debet, salva
quod debebatur, fidejussor solverit. Etsi e-
jus recuperandi quod solvit, pro reo princi-
pali, non habeat mandati actionem. Id quod
evenit, si pro nolente, & invito, semet i-
psum interposuerit, adeoque forte amore rei
